plan.summary: This 4-week block starts the 12-week off-camp build for boxing with one focused S&C session each week that fits around higher sparring volume. Week 1 establishes a baseline on the main lower-body strength lift so future loading can be adjusted cleanly, and the main training work begins in Week 2. With only one 45-minute session per week, the plan keeps power first, then simple strength work, then a small amount of upper-body pulling, trunk work, and brief neck support.

phaseOverview.label: Building
phaseOverview.focus: Build general strength and simple explosive qualities with low-complexity exercises that do not interfere with boxing work.

phaseOverview.label: Intensifying
phaseOverview.focus: Progress the main strength work and keep power output sharp while trimming any volume that clashes with sparring.

phaseOverview.label: Expressing
phaseOverview.focus: Shift toward faster, sharper output with enough strength work to hold onto the force gains built earlier.

exercises.name: Countermovement Jump
exercises.notes: Reset between reps and jump as fast as possible. Land softly and stop if height drops.

substitutionOptions.name: Box Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Use a low box and land quietly with full control.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat
exercises.notes: Warm up with small jumps in load, then work to one hard set of 3-5 clean reps. This establishes your starting strength level for the next block, so stop before form breaks.

strengthAssessment.prompt: Warm up progressively, then work up to your heaviest clean set of 3-5 reps. Log the load and reps so the app can set your starting baseline.

performanceTarget.prompt: Track your best clean top set and use the same squat depth each time.

substitutionOptions.name: Double Dumbbell Front Squat
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if the goblet hold limits load before the legs do.

exercises.name: One-Arm Dumbbell Row
exercises.notes: Use a steady torso and pull the elbow toward the hip. Leave 1-2 good reps in reserve.

substitutionOptions.name: Chest-Supported Dumbbell Row
substitutionOptions.notes: Good option if lower-back support helps you stay tighter.

substitutionOptions.name: Band Row
substitutionOptions.notes: Use a slow return and squeeze the finish if dumbbells are limited.

exercises.name: Push-Up
exercises.notes: Keep the body straight and stop 1-2 reps before form slips. Elevate the hands if needed to keep reps clean.

substitutionOptions.name: Hands-Elevated Push-Up
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if floor push-ups are too difficult to keep clean.

substitutionOptions.name: Dumbbell Floor Press
substitutionOptions.notes: Use a neutral grip and control the pause on the floor.

exercises.name: Front Plank
exercises.notes: Brace hard, keep ribs down, and hold a straight line without sagging.

substitutionOptions.name: Hard-Style Dead Bug
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if the plank position bothers the shoulders.

exercises.name: Supine Neck Flexion Hold
exercises.notes: Very light effort. Tuck the chin slightly and hold steady without shaking.

substitutionOptions.name: Seated Band Neck Flexion
substitutionOptions.notes: Use very low tension and smooth control.

exercises.name: Countermovement Jump
exercises.notes: Reset each rep and jump with full intent. Keep contacts crisp and quiet.

substitutionOptions.name: Box Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Use a low box and step down between reps.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat
exercises.notes: Use a load that leaves about 2 reps in reserve on each set. Stay tall and hit the same depth every rep.

performanceTarget.prompt: Track the load you can repeat for solid sets of 6 with about 2 reps left.

substitutionOptions.name: Double Dumbbell Front Squat

exercises.name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift

substitutionOptions.name: Single-Leg Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
